name: James Han
source:
Dr. James Han is Garrett's homeroom teacher, although that's Dr. "Jazz Hands" to you. A teacher first and psychologist second, he enjoys interacting with his students and is pretty chill. As his nickname implies, he enjoys listening to jazz in his free time. 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20120]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
